streaks.title: 3-day streak
streaks.hint: Act in the game three days in a row.

streaks.title: 14-day streak
streaks.hint: Every day of a founding fortnight.

sources.title: Play today
sources.hint: Any in-game action counts. Signing in alone does not.

sources.title: Claim a quest
sources.hint: Claim any daily or weekly quest.

sources.title: Fight the campaign
sources.hint: Resolve a campaign or camp raid.

sources.title: Win a PvP raid
sources.hint: Take at least one star from another player. Up to 20 wins a day.

sources.title: Hold a defence
sources.hint: An attacker leaves your base with zero stars.

sources.title: Work the Gold Forge
sources.hint: Deploy Shards into the Gold Forge.

sources.title: Spend SOL in-game
sources.hint: Any SOL purchase credited (builder, mine, expansion, shield, energy…).

sources.title: Send feedback
sources.hint: Feedback pays through its own rules (see FEEDBACK); this only marks the day.

sources.title: A friend played today
sources.hint: Per qualified friend (owns land, Keep 3+) who acted today. Nothing on days they skip.

milestones.title: Sign in with your wallet
milestones.hint: Connect and sign the SIWS message once.

milestones.title: Finish the tutorial
milestones.hint: Complete every tutorial step (replayable from the menu).

milestones.title: Upgrade a Mine
milestones.hint: Any Mine reaches level 2 or higher.

milestones.title: Collect mined shards
milestones.hint: Tap a Mine to collect its buffer.

milestones.title: Equip hero gear
milestones.hint: Equip any item on a hero.

milestones.title: Unlock an elite troop
milestones.hint: Consume a training writ won from the Gold Forge.

milestones.title: Earn a star
milestones.hint: Win at least 1★ in a PvP raid.

milestones.title: Hold a defense
milestones.hint: An attacker leaves your base with 0★.

milestones.title: Claim a Forge payout
milestones.hint: Claim KEEP from a settled cycle.

milestones.title: Build the Gold Forge
milestones.hint: Place the Gold Forge on your land.

milestones.title: Buy land
milestones.hint: Pay the land price on devnet and receive your deed.

milestones.title: Deed minted
milestones.hint: Your Land Deed NFT exists on devnet.

milestones.title: Transfer a deed
milestones.hint: Send a deed to another wallet; the base follows.

milestones.title: Claim a mail reward
milestones.hint: Open your mail and claim a reward.

milestones.title: Invite a friend
milestones.hint: A friend joins with your code.

milestones.title: Your friend qualifies
milestones.hint: Your invitee buys land and reaches Keep 3.
